title: German greetings & introductions
examples: How do I say hello in German?
What is the difference between 'du' and 'Sie'?
Can you teach me how to introduce myself?

explain.say: Today we learn some German words for greetings.
Another way to greet someone is with 'Guten Morgen'.
To say your name you can say 'Ich heiße'.
We use 'du' when talking to a friend or a child.
We use 'Sie' when talking to someone you do not know well.
Let us practice saying hello and introducing ourselves now.

faq.q: What is the difference between 'du' and 'Sie'?
faq.a: Du is used for people you know well, like friends or family. Sie is used for people you do not know well, like teachers or older people.

faq.q: How do I say 'good afternoon' in German?
faq.a: You can say 'Guten Tag' which means good day. It is a common greeting for the afternoon.
asks: What is the German for afternoon?
Can I use 'Guten Tag' all day?

faq.q: If I want to introduce myself, what do I say?
faq.a: You should say 'Ich heiße' followed by your name. This means I am called.
asks: How do I say my name in German?
What phrase do I use to introduce myself?

faq.a: Hallo is a very common and friendly way to say hello. It works in many situations.

faq.q: What should I say if I meet a teacher?
faq.a: You should use 'Guten Tag' and address them with 'Sie'. This shows respect.
asks: Do I use 'du' with my teacher?

facts: Hallo is a general, informal greeting.
'Guten Tag' is a standard, polite greeting.
The phrase 'Ich heiße' means 'I am called'.
Use 'du' for informal people and 'Sie' for formal people.

quiz.say: If you are talking to your best friend, which word do you use?
quiz.why: You use 'du' because a best friend is someone you know well.

wrong.0: This is a greeting, not a pronoun.
wrong.1: This is used for saying your name.
wrong.3: This is too formal for a close friend.

quiz.say: What do you say to a principal you have never met?
quiz.why: You use 'Guten Tag' for a formal greeting and 'Sie' to show respect.

wrong.1: Using 'Du' is too informal for a principal.
wrong.2: You need a greeting first, not just your name.
wrong.3: The greeting must match the formality level.

quiz.say: If you want to say 'I am called Tom', what do you say?
quiz.why: The structure 'Ich heiße' means 'I am called' and takes your name.

wrong.0: The grammar structure is incorrect for stating a name.
wrong.1: This incorrectly uses the informal pronoun 'du'.
wrong.2: This is just a greeting, not a full introduction.
